_meta.placement: Draw over the floor cell, after the floor layer. Cell 0 descends, cell 1 ascends. Both flights run north -- away from the viewer, up the frame -- so a flight facing another way needs the cell rotated by the consumer, which costs nothing at 32x32.
_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED by scripts/build_sprite_reference.mjs against the PNG header (64x32 / 32 = 2x1, 2 frames, no remainder). Generated from verdant/dungeon_stairs.json — do not hand-edit; re-run the script instead. Frame names are the exporter's own, kept verbatim so a re-export cannot drift from the reference.
